# Mrinal's software portfolio

> Public-data and financial-risk software by Mrinal, also known as beepboop2025 on GitHub.

This site is the portfolio index for the products below. Use each product's own site or repository as the source for current methods, releases, limits, and results.

## Products

- [LiquiLens](https://liquilens.in/): Early warning for bank and lender distress from public filings, funding structure, regulatory thresholds, and market signals.
- [Seiche](https://seiche.info/): Open-source dollar-funding stress terminal built from Federal Reserve and money-market data.
- [Palimpsest](https://palimpsest.info/): Tamper-evident public records for AI evaluation results and censorship events.
- [Undertow](https://liquilens-undertow.com/): Market-liquidity monitoring for exit cost, venue concentration, and depth collapse.
- [Groundcheck](https://groundcheck.seiche.info/): Claim verification with verdicts, confidence scores, citations, and signed delivery receipts.
- [NarcoScope](https://drug-price-observatory.vercel.app/): Research explorer for public UNODC, INCB, and EUDA drug-trade data.
